## Request latency

Across the whole trace (offsets 0–30,623 ms), `kvstore` made **22,166 `recvfrom` calls**. Their median latency was **0.149 ms**, the p99 was **24.777 ms**, and the maximum was **26.776 ms**. So the p99 was about **166× the median**; the analysis labels this a **long tail**, with the slowest 1% of calls taking at least 5× the median.

This measures `recvfrom` syscall latency, not end-to-end application request latency; the trace does not identify individual application requests.
